description: Defines the SavedSearch class extending SugarBean, managing saved search functionalities including form rendering, retrieval, saving, deletion, and request population within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

classes.name: SavedSearch
classes.description: Represents saved search entities, providing methods for form display, retrieval, saving, deletion, and request handling within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SavedSearch object with optional columns, order, and sort parameters.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the saved search form HTML for a given module, with options for inline display and order-only selection.

methods.name: getTemplateGroupChooser
methods.description: Creates and returns a TemplateGroupChooser object for selecting display columns.

methods.name: getSelect
methods.description: Returns HTML for a dropdown of saved searches for a specific module.

methods.name: returnSavedSearch
methods.description: Redirects to the index page with parameters to load a specific saved search.

methods.name: returnSavedSearchContents
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the contents of a saved search by ID.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Marks a saved search as deleted and redirects to the list view.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current search parameters as a saved search and optionally redirects.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Performs a redirect to the list view with saved search parameters.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional list fields like search_module and assigned_user_name.

methods.name: retrieveSavedSearch
methods.description: Loads a saved search by ID and unserializes its contents.

methods.name: populateRequest
methods.description: Populates $_REQUEST and $_GET with saved search contents for display.
